title: Soluna Holdings, Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Soluna Holdings, Inc received a Nasdaq notice on April 10, 2026 that its common stock closing bid price had fallen below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, putting it out of compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has until October 7, 2026 to regain compliance by achieving a closing bid price of $1.00 or higher for at least ten consecutive business days.
key_points: Nasdaq notified Soluna Holdings (ticker: SLNH) on April 10, 2026 that its common stock fell below $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days
Company is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market
First compliance period: 180 calendar days, ending October 7, 2026
To regain compliance: closing bid price must meet or exceed $1.00 for minimum ten consecutive business days
If not compliant by October 7, company may qualify for a second 180-day compliance period
The notice has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Common Stock
Company intends to monitor bid price and consider available strategies to regain compliance
